{'text': '去年 iPhone 17 Pro 嘅 Cosmic Orange 配色一推出即大受歡迎，不過有消息指 iPhone 18 Pro 將以全新酒紅色取代佢。根據最新爆料，以下係預計會見到嘅嘢。', 'source': 'iPhone 17 Pro’s Cosmic Orange proved a massive hit when it launched last year, but the iPhone 18 Pro is rumored to be replacing it with a brand new shade of red. Here’s what we’re expecting to see, based on the latest leaks.'}

{'text': 'iPhone 18 Pro 主要新色預計係點', 'source': 'What is the expected main new color for iPhone 18 Pro?'}

{'text': '過去 Apple 嘅 Pro 型號 iPhone 一直沿用低調嘅配色，但喺 iPhone 17 Pro 做出咗大轉變。冇再局限於黑白灰等色調，Apple 推出咗搶眼嘅 Cosmic Orange 配色，随即大受歡迎。', 'source': 'Apple’s Pro iPhones have historically been available in muted shades, but the iPhone 17 Pro marked a significant change. Rather than sticking to black, white, and gray, Apple opted for a bold Cosmic Orange colorway, which proved to be a huge hit.'}

{'text': '消息指公司計劃為 iPhone 18 Pro 沿用同樣大膽嘅方向。', 'source': 'The company is reportedly planning to continue that bold approach with the iPhone 18 Pro.'}

{'text': '不過今次唔係再推橙色，而係預計會提供三（或者四）種顏色：', 'source': 'Rather than sticking with orange, however, three (or possibly four) colors are expected to be on offer:'}

  • {'text': '酒紅色／深櫻桃色', 'source': 'Burgundy / dark cherry red'}
  • {'text': '淺藍色', 'source': 'Light blue'}
  • {'text': '銀色', 'source': 'Silver'}
  • {'text': '可能仲有深灰色', 'source': 'Possibly dark gray, too'}

{'text': '至於今年會否有深灰或黑色版本，消息仍然唔明確，但其餘三種顏色就有相當強嘅共識。', 'source': 'It’s unclear whether a dark gray or black option will be offered this year, but there’s a reasonably strong consensus around the other three.'}

{'text': '喺呢幾隻顏色入面，深櫻桃色／酒紅色預計會成為新嘅主打色，亦係 Apple 市場推廣嘅重點。', 'source': 'Of these, the dark cherry / burgundy shade is expected to be the new hero color, and the focus of Apple’s marketing efforts.'}

{'text': '爆料人 Fixed Focus Digital 今日喺微博發文話，佢喺網上見過呢隻顏色嘅深淺兩種版本，但佢認為正確嘅色調係較深嗰隻，一種帶紫紅色調、似櫻桃嘅顏色。', 'source': 'Leaker Fixed Focus Digital posted on Weibo today to say that they had seen two versions of this color online, but they believe the correct shade is the darker one: a cherry-like color with purple undertones.'}

{'text': '部分報道將呢隻顏色單純稱為「紅色」或「深紅色」，呢個可能解釋到點解部分模型圖睇落偏向較淺、紅色為主嘅效果。但根據爆料人所講，我哋將會見到嘅係帶紫調嘅櫻桃色。', 'source': 'Some reports have simply referred to this color as “red” or “dark red,” which may explain why some mock-ups have looked more like a lighter, predominantly red shade. But according to the leaker, what we’re going to see is a cherry red with hints of purple.'}

{'text': '你對 iPhone 18 Pro 嘅傳聞主打色有咩睇法？歡迎喺留言講吓你嘅意見。', 'source': 'What are your thoughts on the rumored hero color for iPhone 18 Pro? Drop us a comment with your opinion.'}
